dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, interconnected 'O' and 'C' shaped light-grey rings on the posterior-right lateral flank; borders exhibit sharp contrast transitions from dark grey/black exteriors to lighter interior fills.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of isolated, high-intensity white/light-grey circular blobs localized mainly on the anterior-dorsal surface and central-lateral transition zone.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest posterior rings form an obtuse triangle, while smaller high-intensity blobs on the mid-section form a roughly trapezoidal configuration.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly symmetrical light-colored mask-like rings surrounding the ocular regions on the dark-pigmented head.
